title: A penalty charge (loan 18, charge 13, amount 67.89) is created then waived whole: amountWaived moves 0 -> 6789, amountOutstanding 6789 -> 0 and the waived flag flips true while paid stays FALSE
_note: Parity vector transcribing the loan-18 PENALTY charge (loanChargeId 13, charge definition 4, OHLGR-Penalty-Flat-57, amount 67.89, SDD due 2026-02-15) through its creation and single waiver on the running Fineract server under tenant gerege, business date 2026-09-03. request.charge_lifecycle transcribes the charge's amount (67.89 -> 6789 minor), its penalty flag (true) and the one observed operation: the waiver POST /loans/18/charges/13?command=waive (step 4, tx71 loanTransactionType.waiveCharges, 2026-02-15). expect.charge_states transcribes the observed charge fields (amountPaid / amountWaived / amountOutstanding plus the paid and waived flags) from the created read-back and the after-waive read-back. This vector grades ONE property: a waiver moves the whole outstanding into amountWaived (0 -> 6789), clears amountOutstanding (6789 -> 0) and flips waived true while paid stays false. The waived penalty leaves the loan ACTIVE because the fee is still outstanding; journal entries remain 4. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every state cell is read directly from the committed files.

provenance.note: request.charge_lifecycle.amount_minor and penalty flag are read from out/loan-18-created-detail-raw.json (charge 13, 67.89, penalty true); request.charge_lifecycle.operations is the single waive step (POST /loans/18/charges/13?command=waive); expect.charge_states are the observed charge-13 cells in out/loan-18-created-detail-raw.json and out/loan-18-after-waive-detail-raw.json. Captures are single-line JSON documents, so line 1 is the observation. capture_case_id names the loan externalId OHCHGCAP-L01, which appears in the referenced capture.
